title: IRIS AI WALLET
description:
These are the things we saw with wallets:
A) Very intrusive pop-up interfaces
B) Complex jargon that is beyond the casual user's understanding
C) A high entry barrier that blocks new people from venturing into it
D) Common occurence of scams, usually high-level ones that shake the industry to the core

**Links**
- [https://github.com/ETH-india/](https://github.com/ETH-india/)
how_its_made:
We were really trying to make the product as secure as possible being a wallet which side tracked us a lot until when we talked to a mentor and then we were back.
The tech side was also kind of hard as this was the first time any of us were playing with AI.
